page: OVHcloud c3-128-flex is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by KVM virtualization and AMD EPYC x86_64 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The instance provisions 64 dedicated vCPUs with a strict one-to-one physical core mapping without simultaneous multithreading. Memory allocation is configured at 128 GB of RAM, establishing a 2 GB per core allocation ratio typical of compute-heavy configurations. Local storage includes a bundled 50 GB NVMe SSD, while network interfaces provide an 8 Gbps baseline throughput.

Benchmark measurements indicate exceptional multi-threaded execution capabilities. In stress-ng multi-core testing, the instance achieved a score of 194,726.03, placing it within the top 10% tier. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression also hit the top 10% tier at 777.66 GB/sec. The instance delivers high caching and throughput efficiency, demonstrated by 128.57 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and 50.44 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. Uncached memory read and write bandwidth remain moderate at 84.41 GB/sec and 43.18 GB/sec respectively.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, the provision of 64 fully dedicated physical cores eliminates noisy-neighbor CPU contention, maximizing sustained multi-core performance per hardware allocation. The primary tradeoff lies in the relatively constrained local storage volume of 50 GB and a moderate 2 GB per core memory footprint, which bounds memory-dense in-memory databases.

OVHcloud c3-128-flex is suited for parallel processing workloads, multi-threaded batch operations, high-volume static web serving, automated CI/CD build environments, and CPU-bound ETL data pipelines.
description: OVHcloud c3-128-flex is a compute-optimized cloud instance powered by AMD EPYC processors on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs running at 2.3 GHz, 128 GB of memory yielding a 2 GB per core ratio, 50 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage, and an 8 Gbps network baseline. Performance benchmarks highlight exceptional multi-threaded throughput, placing in the top tier for multi-core stress testing, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and Redis SET operations exceeding 128 million operations per second. While single-threaded performance and uncached memory bandwidth represent balanced middle-tier metrics, the absence of hyperthreading delivers predictable compute scaling without shared thread contention. OVHcloud c3-128-flex is engineered for computationally intensive workloads including continuous integration pipelines, batch data processing, distributed compilation, and high-concurrency web services.
